```{r}
############################################################
# SIMULATION PLOTS (run AFTER you have the .rds outputs)
############################################################
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

# ---- read saved results ----
m1 <- readRDS("method1_glm_wald_results.rds") %>%
  transmute(
    scenario,
    method = "Method 1: Linear GLM (Wald)",
    coverage = coverage,
    exp_width = exp_width
  )

m2 <- readRDS("method2_spline_boot_contrast_results.rds") %>%
  transmute(
    scenario,
    method = "Method 2: Spline GLM (Bootstrap contrast)",
    coverage = coverage,
    exp_width = exp_width
  )

m3 <- readRDS("method3_jackknife_results.rds") %>%
  transmute(
    scenario,
    method = "Method 3: Linear GLM (Jackknife)",
    coverage = coverage,
    exp_width = exp_width
  )

sim_sum <- bind_rows(m1, m2, m3) %>%
  mutate(
    scenario = factor(scenario, levels = c("A_linear", "B_quadratic", "C_interaction")),
    method = factor(method, levels = c(
      "Method 1: Linear GLM (Wald)",
      "Method 3: Linear GLM (Jackknife)",
      "Method 2: Spline GLM (Bootstrap contrast)"
    ))
  )

# ---- FIGURE 1: Coverage ----
p_cov <- ggplot(sim_sum, aes(x = scenario, y = coverage, group = method, shape = method)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.95, linetype = 2) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Simulation scenario",
    y = "Empirical 95% CI coverage",
    shape = "Method",
    title = "Coverage across methods and scenarios"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

ggsave("fig_sim_coverage.png", p_cov, width = 7, height = 4.2, dpi = 300)

# ---- FIGURE 2: Expected interval width ----
p_wid <- ggplot(sim_sum, aes(x = scenario, y = exp_width, group = method, shape = method)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    x = "Simulation scenario",
    y = "Expected CI width",
    shape = "Method",
    title = "Expected interval width across methods and scenarios"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

ggsave("fig_sim_width.png", p_wid, width = 7, height = 4.2, dpi = 300)

# Show in RStudio viewer
p_cov
p_wid

```
